programme.title: Data Science, Bachelor of Science and Master of Science (Technology)
programme.campus: Otaniemi campus, Espoo (Aalto's main campus; the programme page itself does not name a campus)
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science (Technology) + Master of Science (Technology), 3+2 years, 180+120 ECTS; organising school: School of Science
programme.equivalence_note: Aalto has no English-taught bachelor titled 'Computer Science' (the Computer Science major is taught in Finnish). The closest official English-taught equivalent is the Data Science major of the Aalto Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology, which the Department of Computer Science lists as its only English-taught bachelor's major ('Data Science (in English)'). Alternative: Computer Engineering major (School of Electrical Engineering, hardware/software, same fees, dates and admission rules).

quotes.quote: The language of instruction in the Aalto Bachelor’s Programme in Science and Technology and the Data Science major is English. The programme is conducted entirely in English, meaning that all courses and exams are in English.
Take a virtual tour of Aalto University's campus in Otaniemi, Espoo.

programme.how_found: WebSearch (aalto.fi) 'Aalto University Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology Data Science English-taught' -> programme page. Cross-checked: https://www.aalto.fi/en/study-at-aalto/bachelors-programmes-in-english (lists Data Science and Computer Engineering) and https://www.aalto.fi/en/department-of-computer-science/education (lists 'Data Science (in English)', 'Computer Science (in Finnish)'). Campus: Data Science page -> footer link 'Campus' -> https://www.aalto.fi/en/campus.

english.quote: All students are expected to have sufficient language skills to be able to study in English. You are not required to submit a language test result.
english.how_found: Data Science programme page -> link 'English-taught bachelor's programmes - I am applying with a high school diploma' (admission round A instructions for qualifications completed outside Finland, Updated: 8.10.2026); quote sits under 'Language requirements:' in the section 'Study options in the Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology'.
english.notes: No IELTS/TOEFL minimum is published for this programme: Aalto does not require a language test for English-taught bachelor's programmes in science and technology (language tests are required only for Design and Media). Corroborated by the Bachelor's admissions FAQ (Updated: 10.6.2026): 'No official proof of English skill level is required in the fields of Science and Technology and Business and Economics.' (https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/bachelors-admissions-frequently-asked-questions)

value.description: No GPA or school-grade threshold is published. An applicant with a non-Finnish secondary qualification (e.g. Kazakhstan NIS grade-12 diploma) applies in admission round A, where admission is based solely on SAT or ACT scores with a published minimum: SAT total at least 1350 AND SAT Mathematics at least 700 (or ACT composite at least 29 AND ACT Mathematics at least 30). Applicants above the minimum are ranked by test score; the highest scores are admitted.
value.metric: SAT (total and Mathematics section) or ACT

gpa.quote: Minimum score requirement: SAT total score at least 1350 or ACT composite score at least 29 and SAT Mathematics section score at least 700 or ACT Mathematics section score at least 30.
gpa.how_found: Data Science programme page -> link 'English-taught bachelor's programmes - I am applying with a high school diploma'; the quoted line is in the section 'Study options in the Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology' (six study options incl. Data Science). Who applies in round A: https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/english-taught-bachelors-programmes-in-science-and-technology-or-business-and-economics-admission ('If you have completed any other qualification than the ones listed above, you must apply in the admission round A.').
gpa.notes: Same page: 'In admission round A, the admission is based on SAT or ACT test results.' and 'The applicants are ranked based on their SAT or ACT test scores. The applicants with the highest scores are admitted to the programme.' Required sections: Evidence-Based Reading and Writing + Mathematics (SAT). 'Only the SAT and ACT tests completed 1 January 2025 or later will be considered in the 2027 admissions.' Results must be available to Aalto by 29 January 2027 at 3pm/15.00 (UTC+2). Tie break: higher Mathematics section score. The diploma must give eligibility to university-level studies in the awarding country. FAQ corroboration (https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/bachelors-admissions-frequently-asked-questions): 'The minimum requirements are, for the study options in the field of science and technology, a total score of 1350 and a Mathematics score of 700'.

deadline.quote: Read the instructions below and fill in the application form for admission round A here during the application period 7 to 22 January 2027.
deadline.how_found: Data Science programme page (header 'Application period: 7 Jan 2027 – 22 Jan 2027') -> link 'English-taught bachelor's programmes - I am applying with a high school diploma' (admission timeline for round A).
deadline.notes: This is the autumn 2027 intake: the round-A timeline on the same page lists '7 January 2027 at 8am/8.00 (UTC+2)' (opens) and '22 January 2027 at 3pm/15.00 (UTC+2)' (closes); SAT/ACT results, test report copy and ID/diploma attachments due 29 January 2027 at 3pm/15.00 (UTC+2); the page refers to 'the beginning of the academic year (1 August 2027)'. Corroborated by https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/english-taught-bachelors-programmes-in-science-and-technology-or-business-and-economics-admission ('Both admission rounds are open from 7 to 22 January 2027.') and https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/apply-to-bachelors-programmes-in-english ('The next application period for programmes taught in English is 7–22 January 2027.'). Application is via the national Studyinfo portal linked from these pages.

tuition.quote: The tuition fee for this programme is 12 000 euros per academic year. Citizens of European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA) or Switzerland do not pay tuition fees. Citizens of other countries must pay tuition fees.
tuition.how_found: WebSearch (aalto.fi) 'Aalto University Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology Data Science English-taught' -> programme page, section 'Tuition fees and scholarships' (Updated: 1.10.2026). Fee table: WebSearch 'Aalto University tuition fees non-EU/EEA bachelor's programme per academic year' -> https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/scholarships-and-tuition-fees
tuition.notes: The figure is quoted from the programme page for the January 2027 application round (study right begins 1 August 2027), so it is the fee currently published for the 2027/28 intake; the header also reads 'For non-EU/EEA citizens, €12000/y (Bachelor’s studies) + €17000/y (Master’s studies)'. Aalto publishes no separately labelled 2027/28 fee table: the university-wide table at https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/scholarships-and-tuition-fees (Updated: 15.10.2026) lists 'Field of Technology' '€12 000 per academic year' under 'Tuition fees for rights to study beginning on or after 1 August 2025', and https://www.aalto.fi/en/international-students/paying-the-tuition-fee states 'Aalto University reserves all rights to make changes to the tuition fee levels.' New bachelor's students get a 25% reduction on the first-year fee if they accept the offer bindingly and pay within 21 days of the acceptance letter (EUR 9 000 for Technology).

scholarship_exists.quote: Aalto University Excellence Scholarships are awarded as tuition fee waivers that cover the full tuition fee. Aalto University Excellence Scholarships do not cover living costs.
scholarship_exists.how_found: WebSearch (aalto.fi) 'Aalto University scholarships for non-EU/EEA bachelor's students tuition fee waiver' -> 'Scholarships and Tuition Fees' page (also linked from the Data Science programme page as 'Scholarships and Tuition Fees webpage'), section 'Aalto University Excellence Scholarship'.
scholarship_exists.notes: University-run, merit-based tuition-fee waiver for which incoming bachelor's applicants liable to tuition fees are considered at admission: 'Only students who are liable to pay tuition fees are eligible to apply for Aalto University Excellence Scholarship, i.e. tuition fee waiver.' and 'You can apply for the Aalto University Excellence Scholarship only when you apply for admission.' Very limited number; 'Programmes may decide not to grant any scholarships.' Covers tuition only; living costs (at least 800 euros per month) are not covered. Student-facing terms: https://www.aalto.fi/en/international-students/scholarships-study-right-started-on-or-after-1-august-2025.

scholarship_international.quote: If you are a non-EU/EEA citizen liable to tuition fees, you can apply for the scholarship when you apply to Aalto University. The scholarship application is part of the application form for admission.
scholarship_international.how_found: Same 'Scholarships and Tuition Fees' page, section 'Aalto University Excellence Scholarship' -> 'How to apply'.
scholarship_international.notes: The scholarship is open only to international (non-EU/EEA) applicants: 'You are not eligible to apply if you are a citizen of a European Union (EU) or European Economic Area (EEA) country.' Corroborated by the Bachelor's admissions FAQ (https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/bachelors-admissions-frequently-asked-questions): 'Non-EU/EEA applicants who are liable to tuition fees can apply for the Aalto University Excellence Scholarship as part of their application form for admission. The scholarship decision is given at the same time with the admission decision.' A Kazakhstan citizen paying non-EU/EEA fees is therefore eligible to be considered.

access_notes: The programme-specific admission page 'Admission to Aalto Bachelor's Programme in Science and Technology, Bachelor and Master of Science in Technology (3 yrs + 2 yrs)' returned HTTP 403 Forbidden at all three URL variants (study-at-aalto/...-master-of-science-in, admission-services/...-master-of-science-in, study-at-aalto/...-bachelor-and-master) via both WebFetch and plain curl; the block was not bypassed. The equivalent official round-A instructions page 'English-taught bachelor's programmes - I am applying with a high school diploma' (linked from the programme page, Updated: 8.10.2026) and the Bachelor's admissions FAQ were used instead and contain the same 2027 criteria.
The PDF https://www.aalto.fi/sites/default/files/2025-10/Aalto-Open-days-Bachelors-how-to-apply_2025.pdf (18 pages, 5.1 MB) has no extractable text layer in the fetch tool; it was not used.
Guessed URL https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/sat-and-act-tests returned 404; the real page is /en/admission-services/delivering-sat-and-act-test-scores.

The Data Science programme page does not name a campus; the campus statement is taken from https://www.aalto.fi/en/campus, reached via the programme page footer. Aalto's International Business bachelor is in Mikkeli, but all science and technology study options are at the Otaniemi campus.

Pages were read with WebFetch (HTML-to-markdown) and, for verbatim quoting, with curl plus HTML-tag stripping; all quotes were copied from the stripped page text. No login, no JavaScript rendering needed for the pages used.
